goal: Context size review: what is sent to the model on each call, and what could be left out.
use: Context size review: what is sent to the model on each call, and what could be left out. Use when an agent or model call builds its own context.

steps.note: List the inputs. Each part of the prompt, its source and its typical size.
Find the waste. Flag repeated text, full files where a section is enough, and logs pasted whole.
Check the order. Keep stable content first so it can be cached.
Check the limit. Note what happens when the input is over the model's limit.
Report. Each input with its size, the waste found and the change that saves most.
